text.text_excerpt: Went to Kaylas this morning and was very impressed! I live down the street and have been excited to check it out since they opened. The menu is super cheap ($6 and I was full) but the food sets it apart from all the other places on St. Claude doing poboys and local cuisine. I love that it is totally non pretentious, classic new orleans style spot with great food and service. There's a cool bar area in the front for when they get a liquor license and larger tables upstairs. We have needed more places like this in the neighborhood. I recommend the shrimp or fish poboys (both fried to perfection) which come with tasty seasoned french fries. My friend got the shrimp salad and was very pleased...

Such a welcome addition to the neighborhood. Kayla's food is super and there is nothing over 6 bucks on the menu! I went in for a shrimp poboy and met the owner Calvin Prescott. He is super friendly and dead set on serving the neighborhood great food at affordable prices. His friendly smile and attention to his customers is just a great as the dishes he serves up. The bread on the poboy wasn't the usual overly chewy crap I seem to get at so many poboy joints but was flaky on the outside and soft on the inside. Perfect for soaking up all the hot sauce. The batter on the shrimp was nicely spiced and golden fried perfection. It also came with a side of thick cut fries! A super delicious frie...

I had the honor of eating at Kayla's Restaurant, only open about 3 weeks now, last Saturday. The owner, Calvin Prescott had a super friendly smile and warmly welcomed us into his restaurant so that we could enjoy the deliciously breaded shrimp po boys, one of several po boys on the menu. The bread was excellent, not too chewy and grilled to perfection. There were plenty of shrimp to be had in each of our po boys and each one came with what looked like handcut fries. What a steal for $5.99! As a resident of Bywater who is sick of overpriced bourgeoisie restaurants popping up left and right, I am thrilled to see Kayla's open in the neighborhood: an affordable, filling and excellently cooked...
